_comment: Provenance for rollout-fixture.jsonl (codex's OWN vendor-native envelope format — the adapter's INPUT) and golden.transcript.acp.jsonl (the canonical schema the adapter must produce — the EXPECTED OUTPUT). Mirrors the provenance discipline of ../../testdata/fixtures/MANIFEST.json (memory 'silent-no-op-failure-mode': assert on real payload content, never just entry counts).

rollout-fixture.jsonl.real_source: ~/.codex/sessions/2026/07/16/rollout-2026-07-16T14-51-39-019f6c7c-18d6-7d63-a2e7-f8da2d1aeedf.jsonl (a live codex CLI tool-calling session on this box, driven through ctxloom's own ACP verification harness)
rollout-fixture.jsonl.real_fields: session id (019f6c7c-18d6-7d63-a2e7-f8da2d1aeedf), model (gpt-5.5), approval_policy (on-request), model_context_window (258400), the exec_command function_call (name, exact arguments string, call_id call_OfxrXuWLSfik7ZgLtgbOViU6), its function_call_output (same call_id, exact output text including 'Process exited with code 0'), both token_count last_token_usage blocks (input/cached/output tokens for each of the session's two model turns), the assistant's final text, and the task_complete duration_ms (7085)
rollout-fixture.jsonl.synthetic: the developer-role permissions-instructions text (shortened placeholder — the real one is a multi-KB boilerplate block the adapter deliberately never reads, see rollout.go's messageEvents doc) and the user prompt text ('Run `echo HELLO_FROM_TOOL_CALL_42` and tell me what it printed.' — a short paraphrase of the real session's actual first user-role turn, which in the real file was a multi-KB AGENTS.md/communication-guidelines injection with no standalone short human prompt to extract verbatim)
rollout-fixture.jsonl.why_not_fully_real: the real rollout file's role=user response_items are multi-kilobyte ctxloom-assembled context injections (AGENTS.md text, project context segments), not a short literal human prompt — copying them verbatim would make this 'small, tight' fixture anything but small. Every field the adapter actually PARSES (session id, model, approval policy, context window, the tool call's name/arguments/call_id/output, both token_count blocks, the real assistant reply, task_complete's duration) is copied byte-for-byte from the real file; only the prose the adapter treats as opaque text content was shortened.

golden.transcript.acp.jsonl.provenance: NOT hand-written — generated by running codex.Adapter{}.Convert against rollout-fixture.jsonl and capturing the Recorder's output verbatim (see codex_test.go's TestConvert_MatchesGolden, which re-generates and diffs against this file on every run — it is a checked-in expectation, not a separate hand-maintained parallel format).
golden.transcript.acp.jsonl.harp/seq/ts: harp and ts are stamped by the test's Recorder construction (a fixed harp, a fixed clock via NewRecorder's now field is NOT overridden here — ts reflects wall-clock test-run time, so the golden comparison in codex_test.go zeroes/ignores ts and harp fields rather than pinning them; seq is deterministic (0..N in file order) and IS asserted verbatim.
